evidence_grades.label: Local confirmed
evidence_grades.meaning: Direct Hays/Kyle sample evidence or site-specific validated measurement.
evidence_grades.dashboard_use: Highest confidence; can support local presence/context claims.

evidence_grades.label: Regional observed
evidence_grades.meaning: Observed in processed NEON/NMDC CLBJ/Texas-like sample outputs.
evidence_grades.dashboard_use: Regional analog evidence; not local confirmation.

evidence_grades.label: Soil habitat inferred
evidence_grades.meaning: Inferred from SSURGO, lab pedon support, and soil ecology rules.
evidence_grades.dashboard_use: Use for likely guilds/functions, not named local taxa claims.

evidence_grades.label: Reference/function-only
evidence_grades.meaning: General literature/tool-based association without local or regional observation.
